title: Closure of Employer Benefit Charging Positions
content:
An Employer Benefit Charging position closes when its claim has closed or been withdrawn and the protest window of the last statement listing it has passed.

A closed position takes no further charges or protests; a credit for an overpayment recovered after closure is still posted on the employer's next statement.

| Claim | Protest window of the last statement listing the position | Position |
|---|---|---|
| Closed or withdrawn | Passed | Closes |
| Closed or withdrawn | Still running | Not yet closed by this rule |
| Still open | Passed | Not yet closed by this rule |

**Points of judgement.**
- After closure, no new charge is posted to the position and no protest is taken on it.
- An overpayment recovered after the position closed still produces its credit, which appears on the employer's next statement.
